entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 1392396172224832896: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 74961: distance 106.896 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.026), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 106.896 +/- 2.779 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 9.5255 +/- 0.0164 mas (same row, RUWE 1.09), 580.6 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -19.906, -181.888 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 4.104 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 74961: radius 4.104 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 8.448 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.057) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4861 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 74961: effective temperature 4861 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.022).

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,861 K and log g 3.38 (u1 0.680, u2 0.106): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. Gravity: log g 3.38 from 2024A&A...691A..53S; the 11 published values span log g 3.38 to 3.6, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.1% of the centre brightness.
